lead.body: The IRGC says two oil tankers and an LNG carrier struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday and caught fire. No ship names were given. US Central Command says the main shipping lanes are mine-free.
lead.headline: THREE TANKERS HIT MINES IN HORMUZ

lead.body: The Houthis say they struck Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery at 550,000 barrels a day. Satellite images show thick black smoke. The Saudi-led coalition says it downed four drones there.
lead.headline: HOUTHIS HIT RAS TANURA REFINERY

lead.body: Washington proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners after an eight-month probe into excess factory capacity. China faces the highest, an extra 20%. A hearing is set for 25 January.
lead.headline: US TARIFFS HIT 14 PARTNERS

small.body: Brent rose to $94.71 in early Asian trade after a 3.5% jump on Wednesday. US crude stocks rose 1.1m barrels.
small.headline: BRENT $94.71 AS GULF ATTACKS LIFT OIL

small.body: Strikes killed at least nine, including Hamas-appointed deputy education minister Khaled Abu Nada and his wife. Third straight night despite the October 2025 ceasefire.
small.headline: ISRAEL KILLS NINE IN GAZA OVERNIGHT

small.body: A tanker master reported an explosion from an unknown projectile 50 nautical miles west of Dubai. Crew safe, no damage.
small.headline: BLAST NEAR TANKER WEST OF DUBAI

small.body: The Dow erased a 1,100-point intraday fall to close up 0.33% at 50,182.95. S&P fell 0.25%, Nasdaq 0.62%. US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.
small.headline: DOW ERASES 1,100-POINT PLUNGE

small.body: The FCC authorised SpaceX to deploy up to one million satellites for its 'Starmind' orbital data-centre constellation. First satellite due by 2033.
small.headline: FCC OKS 1M SPACEX DATA SATELLITES

small.body: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate 25 bps to 3.25% in a 5-2 vote, lifting 2026 growth to 3.9% on the AI chip export boom.
small.headline: BANK OF KOREA HIKES RATE TO 3.25%

small.body: Taiex +3.05%, Kospi +1.88%, Nikkei +1.85%, Hang Seng +1.22%, shrugging off new US tariff proposals after Wednesday's rout.
small.headline: ASIAN STOCKS REBOUND

small.body: EU leaders meet in Brussels in a showdown over a 45bn euro loan for Ukraine and the 2tn euro budget. Macron threatens to quit talks if no deal by 17-18 December.
small.headline: EU SUMMIT CLASH OVER UKRAINE CASH

small.body: A fuel tanker overturned on Cairo's Ring Road and ignited, killing at least 31, injuring 21 and charring 27+ vehicles. Toll preliminary.
small.headline: CAIRO TANKER FIRE KILLS 31

small.body: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed to Saturday, the first delay in its history, as a coastal storm brings 65 mph gusts to New York.
small.headline: MACY'S PARADE MOVED TO SATURDAY
